title: BigQuery Vector Search — Private Pattern 6
description: Template schema for deploying a private BigQuery Vector Search analytical RAG dataset and table with restricted IAM invokers, optional VPC networking, optional GCS staging bucket, and optional private Cloud Run serving layer.

location.description: Geographic location for BigQuery dataset (US, EU, regional).

region.description: GCP region for regional resources (VPC connector, Cloud Run).

display_name.description: Display name prefix for private resources.

allowed_invoker_members.description: List of IAM identities granted BigQuery data viewer and job user permissions.

use_existing_network.description: If true, attach to existing VPC and connector. If false, create new VPC.

network_name.description: Name of new VPC network (when use_existing_network = false).

enable_nat_gateway.description: Whether to provision Cloud NAT for private outbound traffic.

existing_connector_id.description: Existing VPC Access connector ID (when use_existing_network = true).

table_id.description: Name of BigQuery table storing vector embeddings.

delete_contents_on_destroy.description: Whether to delete all tables when destroying dataset.

create_staging_bucket.description: Whether to create a Cloud Storage staging bucket for batch uploading documents or embeddings.

staging_bucket_name.description: Custom name for document staging bucket.

enable_cloud_run.description: Whether to deploy the optional private Cloud Run FastAPI serving layer.

container_image.description: Container image URI for Cloud Run.

min_instances.description: Minimum instances for Cloud Run (kept warm for private SLA).

max_instances.description: Maximum instances for Cloud Run autoscaling.
